description:
## Goal

Make every production ordering of activation-bearing jobs and facts use one total typed semantic relation, independent of World-local type interning, hash discovery order, lossy display/debug rendering, canonical presentation strings, or reused binder-address tokens.

This is a correctness prerequisite discovered by the fz-kdt.46 exact-edge review. It lands separately so the edge ticket contains only edge registration, settlement, arbitration, and causal accounting.

## Proven failures

- Derived ordering of ActivationKey.arrow follows raw Ty arena ids, so opposite mint histories reverse wake and diagnostic order.
- Types::display is non-injective: list(int) and non_empty_list(int) both render as [int].
- Closure-literal captures were not structurally addressed.
- One unscoped variable-correlation map aliases an embedded captured value addressed as a0 with an independent nested callable binder also addressed as a0, while simple precedence changes break intentional arg/return/capture correlation inside one binder.
- Terminal unresolved inventories and product fact waits retained raw FactKey ordering after arbitration moved to a structural relation.

## Correct model

- Embedded values belong to the enclosing activation surface.
- Every ArrowSig introduces an explicit binder scope with its own correlation map; sibling and nested binders are distinct.
- Repeated variables within one binder, including literal captures that actually share the binder variable, remain correlated and addressing is idempotent.
- An unmatched embedded capture is re-owned under its exact Capture path and cannot alias an independent callable binder using the same address token.
- Activation arrows compare through the existing Types::cmp_ty structural relation after complete addressing. That relation reads structure, structural variable paths, and owner-registered callable labels directly; it does not allocate or parse text.
- ActivationKey, Job, FactKey, FactUse, terminal inventory, product fact waits, and completion ordering share typed Types-aware comparison implementations over their real fields. Remove raw Ord where it can silently re-enter.
- TyCanon, Types::display, Debug, formatted strings, separators, and textual fingerprints remain presentation/testing tools only and never determine production order.

## TDD

1. Opposite Ty mint histories plus opposite registration order for display-colliding list/non_empty_list facts produce identical typed semantic order.
2. A generic named closure capture is fully structurally addressed and compares identically across worlds with different local callable ids.
3. The same a0 token used by an embedded prior value and an independent nested callable binder does not alias; intentional arg/return/capture sharing inside the binder remains correlated after repeated addressing.
4. Sibling/nested callable binders push and pop independently.
5. Unresolved diagnostics and product fact waits have identical order across opposite mint histories.
6. Existing ActivationKey equality, transport, native callable behavior, executable inventory, lifecycle counts, canonical artifacts, and runtime behavior remain unchanged.
7. Static/search proof shows no production ordering calls display, Debug formatting, TyCanon rendering, or a string-key helper.

## Required deletion and boundary

Delete superseded display/Debug/canonical-string comparators, blanket preserve-address modes, unscoped correlation attempts, raw FactKey Ord, duplicate tests/docs, and temporary probes. Do not include fz-kdt.46 wait-edge storage, settlement batching, wake arbitration, or session-accounting changes.

## Acceptance

- One faithful typed binder-scoped structural comparison relation owns every activation-bearing observable order.
- No raw Ty/intern/hash identity and no Debug/display/TyCanon string determines production order.
- Addressing is total, non-aliasing, correlated, and idempotent for valid activation arrows and nested callable captures.
- Semantic facts, diagnostics, executable inventory, lifecycle work, backend/native artifacts, and runtime behavior are identical.
- Focused addressing/ordering/transport tests, full CLI/library/matrix as proportionate, formatting, and strict clippy pass.

title: Give activation facts one binder-scoped semantic order
